in_marathi.name: Biswajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Biswajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Biswajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Biswa' meaning 'all' and 'Jit' meaning 'conquered'. This name signifies the one who conquers or rules over all aspects of creation. In Hindu mythology, Biswajit is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
